title: The Truck Buyer's Checklist for 2027: 12 Steps Before You Sign (Step 7 Saves $10,000)
description:
Sixty-seven thousand, five hundred seventy-three dollars. That is what the average full-size pickup sold for in September twenty twenty-six, according to Kelley Blue Book. Add a seven-year loan, record diesel prices and insurance that keeps climbing, and buying a truck has become one of the biggest financial decisions most families will ever make. Yet most buyers spend more time choosing a paint color than checking the numbers.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]
